title: Breeding Place Detection Roboflow V2
subtitle: Augmented YOLO export for mosquito breeding place subclass detection
description: Private upload of the local Roboflow-exported Breeding Place Detection dataset used for FYP Stage 1 retained-class YOLO training. Source classes are Bottle, Coconut-Exocarp, Drain-Inlet, Tire, and Vase. This is an augmented Roboflow export aligned with the VisText-Mosquito class taxonomy, not a byte-identical canonical Mendeley release.
